decision_policy.prefer_existing_repair_when: An existing URL already matches the intent and a specific evidence-backed improvement can make it more extractable/useful.
decision_policy.create_new_url_when: Intent is materially distinct, service/geography are truthful, duplicate risk is low, and the page can meet substance gates.

truth_note: Fanout, pages, indexing, impressions, LLM mentions, and backlinks are not verified citations.
